adm_pm_features_head: ⚙️ Features for {name} Tap a feature or its state to change it. These switches affect only this panel; shop settings and product limits still apply. Disabling new sales does not disable existing services.
adm_pm_ask_name: Send a new panel name (1–64 characters, one line).
adm_pm_ask_capacity: Send capacity (0–1,000,000). 0 or - means unlimited. This cap applies to new provisioning only.
adm_pm_ask_prefix: Send a username prefix: English letters, digits or _, up to 16 characters. Send - to clear. Existing usernames will not change.
adm_pm_invalid_name: Use one line, 1–64 characters and no control characters.
adm_pm_method_help: Choose how future usernames are generated. Existing usernames will not change.
adm_pm_test_fail: ❌ Connection test failed. Check the address and credentials in the secure web panel. Sensitive error details are not displayed here.
adm_pm_reset_help:
Current panel default: {mode}
On: renew with usage reset. Off: renew without resetting usage. An explicit product policy takes precedence. Select shop policy to remove the panel override.
adm_pm_finance_head: 📊 Order report for {name} Completed paid-order amount: {amount} IRT Last 30 days: {last} IRT 30-day daily average: {average} IRT Completed trials: {trials}
adm_pm_finance_note: Scope: completed orders in this shop for services currently on this panel. Free orders are excluded from sales amounts. Moving a service can change report attribution. This is not profit or net revenue after refunds.
